summary: John's 1st cousin 7x removed; Luzerne County Commissioner, last of the 'Davenport congress'.
bio:
Stephen Davenport (1800-1882), son of Thomas and Charity (Lamoreux) Davenport, was a Luzerne County Commissioner and lived later in Huntington Twp.

Giles & Franklin say Stephen, youngest child of Thomas and Charity (Lamoreux) Davenport, was born on 14 Aug 1800 and died on 22 Aug 1882. On 5 May 1822 he married Elizabeth Tubbs (5 May 1802 - 24 Mar 1862). Their children were Hanford (d. 1865, m. Fanny Larned), Thomas M. (b. 1829, m. Diana Good), William (b. 1827, m. 1855 Adaline Harrison), Earl, Samuel, and Charity Adelaide (b. Town Line, Pa., 16/18 Feb 1839, d. Hicks Ferry 9 Sep 1930, m. Charles Good) ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport ... and his Descendants (1962), pp.322-323 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile
